summary: A municipal citizen reporting platform allowing citizens to register/login, submit reports with photos, and track status. Municipal staff (PR, URP, Technical) manage report lifecycle (categorization, review, assignment, status updates). External maintainers can be assigned to resolve issues. Admins manage users/roles/companies. Includes messaging and notifications.

risks: POST /auth/register-request stores data in Redis with TTL; if verification fails or is delayed beyond 30 minutes, registration data expires silently.
POST /auth/register-request replaces existing record for same email; this may overwrite pending registrations without explicit warning.
PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId} (accept) automatically assigns to technical staff via load balancing; no explicit assignment step visible in docs.
GET /messages/reports/{reportId} has complex access control logic not fully specified in parameters (role-based filtering).
POST /upload/photo and POST /upload/photos lack explicit reportId parameter in schema; assumes context from session or header.
DELETE /admin/users/{userId} cannot delete own account; no alternative self-deletion flow documented.
